```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(0)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "Alignment_Benchmarking/Mapping_Accuracy_Analysis/"))

library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)
library("dplyr")
library(factoextra)
```

```{r load mm10 data}
# Load data
data_mm10 <- fread("Combined_saturation_metrics.txt")

head(data_mm10)
```
```{r}
library(data.table)

setDT(data_mm10)

overall_fate <- data_mm10[
    ,
    .(
        total_reads    = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
        unmapped_reads = sum(unmapped, na.rm = TRUE),
        lifted_reads   = sum(lifted, na.rm = TRUE),
        accurate_reads = sum(accurate, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by = .(run_dir, pair_name, subsample_label, subsample_percent, rg)
]

overall_fate[
    ,
    `:=`(
        mapped_reads            = total_reads - unmapped_reads,
        mapped_unliftable_reads = (total_reads - unmapped_reads) - lifted_reads,
        lifted_inaccurate_reads = lifted_reads - accurate_reads,
        lifted_accurate_reads   = accurate_reads
    )
]

overall_fate[
    ,
    `:=`(
        unmapped_pct            = 100 * unmapped_reads / total_reads,
        mapped_unliftable_pct   = 100 * mapped_unliftable_reads / total_reads,
        lifted_inaccurate_pct   = 100 * lifted_inaccurate_reads / total_reads,
        lifted_accurate_pct     = 100 * lifted_accurate_reads / total_reads,
        lifted_pct              = 100 * lifted_reads / total_reads,
        accurate_pct            = 100 * accurate_reads / total_reads,
        accurate_given_lifted_pct = fifelse(
            lifted_reads > 0,
            100 * accurate_reads / lifted_reads,
            NA_real_
        )
    )
]
```

```{r}
mapq_summary <- data_mm10[
    !is.na(mapq_bin),
    .(
        total_reads    = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
        lifted_reads   = sum(lifted, na.rm = TRUE),
        accurate_reads = sum(accurate, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by = .(run_dir, pair_name, subsample_label, subsample_percent, rg, mapq_bin)
]

mapq_summary[
    ,
    `:=`(
        unliftable_reads = total_reads - lifted_reads,
        inaccurate_reads = lifted_reads - accurate_reads
    )
]

mapq_summary[
    ,
    `:=`(
        lifted_within_bin_pct = 100 * lifted_reads / total_reads,
        unliftable_within_bin_pct = 100 * unliftable_reads / total_reads,
        accurate_within_bin_pct = 100 * accurate_reads / total_reads,
        accurate_given_lifted_within_bin_pct = fifelse(
            lifted_reads > 0,
            100 * accurate_reads / lifted_reads,
            NA_real_
        )
    )
]
```

```{r}
mapq_levels <- c("0", "1-9", "10-29", "30-59", "60")

mapq_summary[
    ,
    mapq_bin := factor(mapq_bin, levels = mapq_levels, ordered = TRUE)
]

overall_fate[
    ,
    fate_sum := unmapped_pct + mapped_unliftable_pct + lifted_inaccurate_pct + lifted_accurate_pct
]

summary(overall_fate$fate_sum)

overall_fate[
    ,
    subsample_percent := as.numeric(subsample_percent)
]

mapq_summary[
    ,
    subsample_percent := as.numeric(subsample_percent)
]

setorder(overall_fate, rg, subsample_percent)
setorder(mapq_summary, rg, mapq_bin, subsample_percent)
```


```{r}
overall_fate_long <- melt(
    overall_fate,
    id.vars = c("run_dir", "pair_name", "subsample_label", "subsample_percent", "rg"),
    measure.vars = c(
        "unmapped_pct",
        "mapped_unliftable_pct",
        "lifted_inaccurate_pct",
        "lifted_accurate_pct"
    ),
    variable.name = "fate",
    value.name = "pct"
)

overall_fate_long[
    ,
    fate := factor(
        fate,
        levels = c(
            "unmapped_pct",
            "mapped_unliftable_pct",
            "lifted_inaccurate_pct",
            "lifted_accurate_pct"
        ),
        labels = c(
            "Unmapped",
            "Mapped, unliftable",
            "Lifted, inaccurate",
            "Lifted, accurate"
        )
    )
]

setorder(overall_fate_long, rg, fate, subsample_percent)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
    overall_fate_long,
    aes(
        x = subsample_percent,
        y = pct,
        group = rg
    )
) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.30, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ fate, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = sort(unique(overall_fate_long$subsample_percent))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        labels = percent_format(scale = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Subsample (%)",
        y = "Reads (%)",
        title = "Read fate across subsampling"
    ) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    JFMVTheme
```

```{r}
ggplot(
    mapq_summary,
    aes(
        x = subsample_percent,
        y = lifted_within_bin_pct,
        group = rg
    )
) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.30, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ mapq_bin, nrow = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = sort(unique(mapq_summary$subsample_percent))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        labels = percent_format(scale = 1),
        limits = c(0, 100)
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Subsample (%)",
        y = "Lifted within MAPQ bin (%)",
        title = "Liftability across subsampling by MAPQ bin"
    ) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    JFMVTheme

```

```{r}
overall_fate_2pct <- overall_fate[subsample_percent == 2]
overall_fate_long_2pct <- overall_fate_long[subsample_percent == 2]
mapq_summary_2pct <- mapq_summary[subsample_percent == 2]

rg_order <- overall_fate_2pct[order(lifted_accurate_pct), rg]

overall_fate_2pct[
    ,
    rg := factor(rg, levels = rg_order)
]

overall_fate_long_2pct[
    ,
    rg := factor(rg, levels = rg_order)
]

mapq_summary_2pct[
    ,
    rg := factor(rg, levels = rg_order)
]
```
